description: Design and size a power cable from a sentence (Turkish or English, e.g. "3-core collective screen 12/20 kV 3x95/25 Al, longitudinally watertight") or a spec: every layer's thickness with its source (IEC 60502-1 / -2, IEC 60228), the overall diameter, the DIN VDE 0276 designation and the decoder's reading of it; optional XML, DXF, SVG, CSV, GLB, STEP (3D CAD) and a PDF datasheet. Deterministic, no LLM; a nominal calculation, not a datasheet.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of an earlier answer, changed.

formats.description: Files to include: xml, dxf, svg, csv, glb (base64), step (STEP AP214 text), pdf (datasheet, base64).

sentence.description: The cable in words, Turkish or English: voltage, cores, section, conductor metal, screen, sheath, watertightness, armour. What is not said takes a default, and the answer lists which.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: {voltage: "12/20", cores: 3, section: 95, metal, screen, screenType, screenSection, insulation, sheath, watertight, armour}.

name: design_cable
title: Design and size a power cable
